function greet(name: string, count: number): string {
  const message = `hello ${name}, you have ${count} items`;
  if (count > 0) {
    return message;
  }
  return `hello ${name}`;
}

function matches(input: string): boolean {
  const pattern = /^[a-z]+$/;
  if (pattern.test(input)) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function halve(total: number): number {
  const half = total / 2;
  if (half > 0) {
    return half;
  }
  return 0;
}

function buildPath(segments: string[]): string {
  return segments.map((s) => `/${s}`).join("");
}
